_doc: Bike racks and the bully-borrows-bike loop (story 5.5, CAP-16). Distances in px, times in seconds. A bike parked away from every rack stays unlocked; once every player has been further than awayDistance for awaySeconds, each checkInterval a bully may borrow it (chance) when there is a motive: Aerger >= 1, an active bully, or a bully spawn within motiveRadius. The thief starts at the nearest off-view bully spawn within originRadius, walks to the bike (and gives up when a player gets within scareRadius), rides it to the nearest bike-hideout and the family has to fetch it back.
